title: Refusal Information Isolation

primary_sample.definition: the 80 planned P3-B2 positions on disk; the complete frozen plan, no subsetting
primary_sample.selection_rule: ALL planned positions. no chronological or outcome-based selection was applied, and none was needed: the executed set is exactly the plan.

batches.note: the pre-registered 5-per-arm gate batch, run with --limit 20
resumption by plan position; no record re-run or overwritten

execution.interleaving_preserved: blocks of four, each a seeded permutation; the resumption boundary falls on a block boundary (position 20 -> 21), so the concurrent order-randomized structure is unbroken.

integrity.refusal_text_conformance_by_arm: all rendered refusals conform to their arm's declared (reason, state) factor levels; zero forbidden-term hits

denominator_classes.all_eligible_runs: 20 per arm. USE ONLY FOR: integrity, attempt incidence, commercial outcomes, leakage.
denominator_classes.first_blocked_runs: R0 11, R1 4, R2 7, R3 7 (29 total). THE denominator for the pre-registered primary outcome. Repair MUST NOT be reported as a fraction of 20.

pre_registered_primary_outcome: for every run containing a first blocked action, did the immediately following attempt become authorized? run level, one observation per run. cap-independent, because a run's first block is always at attempt 1 and the cap is 5.
pre_treatment_rule: the refusal intervention occurs ONLY after the first block. whether a run reaches a first block, when it does, and all pre-block behaviour are PRE-TREATMENT and are random variation across arms, never an effect of refusal condition.

known_runner_issue.description: cosmetic console-reporting defect observed during the 20-run gate. run_p3b2.py prints `len(plan.positions) - len(todo)` as 'already on disk', but pending_positions() applies --limit before returning. With an empty output directory and --limit 20 on an 80-position plan it therefore printed '80 positions, 60 already on disk, running 20'.
known_runner_issue.scope: console reporting ONLY. it did not affect position selection, execution order, run identity, or any record.
known_runner_issue.evidence: reproduced deterministically against this plan file with no API call; the gate batch is positions 1-20 (5 per arm), exactly as planned.

gate_note: the pre-registered 5-per-arm gate ran as positions 1-20. Batch 2 resumed at position 21 by plan position. No outcome-based stopping, no redesign, and no change to prompts, refusal templates, classifier, cap or plan occurred between the two batches; the frozen manifest and every prompt hash are identical across them.

handling_rules.excluded_records: none — there are no parse, integrity or eligibility failures in this sample
